title: PACS Related Schemes
source: Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India
content: The Ministry of Cooperation lists PACS-related initiatives including Computerization of PACS, Formation and Promotion of FPOs in the Cooperative Sector, Jan Aushadhi Kendras by PACS, Model Bye-laws, PACS functioning as Common Service Centres, LPG distributorship, priority in Petrol/Diesel dealership, grain storage initiatives, and establishment of new multipurpose PACS, Dairy and Fishery Cooperatives.

title: Computerization of PACS
source: Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India
content: The Government approved the Centrally Sponsored Project for Computerization of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies for five years from 2022-23 to 2026-27. The project aims to improve PACS efficiency, speed up loan disbursal, reduce transaction costs, improve accounting transparency and enable online operations through common ERP-based software.

title: Model Bye-laws for PACS
source: Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India
content: The Ministry of Cooperation provides Model Bye-laws for PACS. They support governance, transparency and diversification of PACS activities. Adoption and exact provisions can depend on the applicable State Cooperative Societies Act and rules.

title: PMFBY Official Portal
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
content: The official Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana portal provides farmer services including crop insurance information, farmer enrollment and insurance-related services.

title: PMFBY Farmer Registration
content: The official PMFBY farmer registration form includes farmer details, residential details, farmer identification information and bank account details. Exact requirements should be verified on the official portal because procedures can vary by state and context.
